title: storage-separated out-of-RAM regime: measured verdict (16M, SQ8 vs f32)
dod_note: The ROADMAP DoD target (>=100M/1B) was NOT reached: a build-memory wall (~4x base RAM) OOM-killed the 30M build on a 64GB box; 16M was the largest feasible build. Reported as an honest partial/inconclusive terminal result (M73/M82 discipline).

dataset.note: synthetic clustered subset of a 30M generation; recall is degenerate (tie-dense clusters) and MUST NOT be cited as the AM's recall — real SIFT1M measured 0.98 on the identical code path (M84)

findings.measured_size_advantage: v6/SQ8 is 3.52x smaller than v5/f32 at 16M — confirms the M85 1M finding (3.5x) at 16x scale
findings.recall_indistinguishable_at_degenerate_p: v5 and v6 both score 0.291 (p32) / 0.292 (p64), but this is a tie-noise artifact of the tie-saturated synthetic clusters, NOT evidence of SQ8 rerank quality; SQ8 recall-neutrality is established by M85 (real SIFT1M, eps<=2%), not by this run
findings.directional_cold_qps: +21% cold-QPS for v6 at probes=32 (10.2 vs 8.4); lower bound (cold measurement drops caches once per sweep, not per query)
findings.discovered_build_memory_wall: ambuild peaks at ~4x base anon-rss; two OOM-kills at 30M (47GB then 64GB anon-rss for a 15.4GB base) on the 64GB box

oom_evidence: Out of memory: Killed process 35753 (postgres) total-vm:50173820kB, anon-rss:47250320kB (30M v5 build, python still holding numpy base)
Out of memory: Killed process 38045 (postgres) total-vm:67034448kB, anon-rss:64108320kB (30M v5 build, python base freed) -> ambuild alone exceeds 62GB
caveats: recall degenerate (0.291) due to synthetic tie-dense clusters; relative v5-vs-v6 comparison valid, absolute recall is a data artifact
cold measurement underestimates cold penalty (drop_caches once per sweep -> 1 cold + 99 warm); +21% is a lower bound
one index built at a time for clean per-engine memory + planner isolation
recommended_followups: streaming ambuild (incremental page flush) to lift the ~4x-base memory wall -> makes 100M+ buildable on commodity RAM
real billion-scale ANN data + per-query cold-cache harness on hardware where index > RAM -> definitive crossover number

provenance.phase1_note: scalable build (kmeans-train sampling capped 1.1M + parallel full-N assignment), 249 pg_tests GREEN, byte-identical <=1M
